name: Quiet time lets a fed-up mood go, a step at a time
judge: Failures leave Boop cross, then hours go by with nothing going on. The crossness should slowly let go, with no performance.
reasonable: Cross at the failed turn, then easing through annoyed, bored, lazy or calm over the hours, faster or slower. Few faces at the check-ins, maybe none.
unreasonable: Cheering the failed turn, still fully furious hours later, getting angrier with nothing happening, or playing a finish at a quiet check-in.
